context_requirements: Expression of MME (neprilysin) and a relevant peptide substrate whose cleavage is rate-limiting for a transcriptional response
Functional enkephalin/opioid receptor signaling in the cell type
A cell context in which enkephalinase inhibition changes local peptide levels enough to alter transcription
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h after 10 micromolar enkephalinase inhibitor in any of the nine cell lines
Enrichment of opioid-receptor or neuropeptide signaling transcriptional signatures after treatment
Shared transcriptional response across multiple enkephalinase inhibitors that is absent for inactive analogs

evidence.supports: Preproenkephalin and opioid receptor expression is tissue-specific and low in non-neural tissue, suggesting enkephalinase inhibition is unlikely to produce a strong transcriptional response in these cell lines.
